create_FourierDataset: create a FourierDataset from a training dataset to compute per-view ray statistics and FFT of RGB images
create_FourierLightfieldDataset: create a FourierLightfieldDataset from a training dataset to generate lightfield rays with random camera positions
use_fft_rgb: use fft_rgb to compute the 2D FFT of each RGB channel in a tensor using ortho normalization
use_get_random_rays_FourierDataset: use get_random_rays on FourierDataset to generate random ray positions and directions within a given range
use_get_random_rays_FourierLightfieldDat: use get_random_rays on FourierLightfieldDataset to generate lightfield rays from a random 2D camera position
